item.title: How to Stop Watching Instagram Reels at Work (Without Deleting Instagram)

item.description: You need YouTube for tutorials and talks, not an endless Shorts feed. Here are the ways to hide or block Shorts on desktop Chrome, and the catch most guides miss.

item.description: Doomscrolling isn't a character flaw, it's a design problem. These eight small, realistic changes help you scroll less without quitting social media entirely.
